name: Star Plastic Design
old_description: Star Plastic specializes in custom thermoforming of blisters, clamshells, tray and tray lids to precise customer specifications. Complete design, tooling, and fast turnarounds are only part of the total services we offer.
about:
Star Plastic Design operates from Harbor City, California, where it has provided custom thermoforming services for over 40 years. The company focuses on visual packaging solutions, serving customers across the western United States and beyond from its single facility.

The manufacturer specializes in custom thermoforming of blisters, clamshells, trays, and tray lids to precise specifications. Its plant houses 12 diverse thermoforming machines, including two large-format Sencorp 2500 units for high-volume production with inline cutting, and three CNC milling machines for rapid tooling, modifications, and repairs. The equipment mix enables forming of materials from 7 mil to 70 mil thickness, covering flocked, metalized, PET, PLA, PE, PVC, PS, and ABS. In-house tool design, CNC prototyping, and on/off-line die cutting allow the company to handle prototype runs through to orders of hundreds of thousands or millions of parts.

Star Plastic serves the cosmetic packaging, industrial packaging, and point-of-purchase display markets, and also manufactures steel-ruled dies for the print and packaging industries. Its customer base includes brands needing product packaging, counter displays, container packaging, and specialized applications such as dental and perfume packaging.

The company emphasizes several differentiators: bilingual customer service for cross-border communication, the ability to adapt a customer's existing tooling to its machines, deep-draw thermoforming up to 6.5 inches or more, automated edge folding for recyclable slide-blister packs, and shared-cost combo runs that combine multiple customers on a single production run. Quick turnarounds — often same-day or next-day — and low-volume economies round out its value proposition, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification.
